decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It aims to cheat these creatures into play early in the game to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces. The main focus of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck includes disruptive cards like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo, as well as powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to dominate the battlefield. The inclusion of Wasteland also provides disruption and control against opponent's lands. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. It also includes support cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to facilitate the combo, along with disruption spells like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan to win the game efficiently. With a mix of card advantage and combo potential, this deck is designed to be fast and aggressive in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard recursion and fast mana to quickly cheat big, impactful creatures into play. The key strategy involves setting up powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier in the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back into play for a low cost. The deck also includes disruption and card selection spells like Force of Will and Brainstorm to protect the combo and ensure consistency in drawing the necessary pieces.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By locking down the opponent's mana base with cards like Magus of the Moon and Blood Moon, while also controlling the board with Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to take control of the game early on. Additionally, the deck utilizes burn spells and creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers to deal direct damage and pressure the opponent, ultimately securing a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact mana and untap effects to generate infinite mana with Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, then casting spells from the top of the library with Mystic Forge. The goal is to assemble a combo quickly, using cards like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key to untap key pieces. Karn, the Great Creator acts as both disruption and combo piece, while Urza's Saga provides additional artifact synergy. The deck can quickly overwhelm opponents by generating large amounts of mana and casting powerful spells from the top of the library.

The essence of this deck is to quickly mill through your library using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to get Narcomoebas and Dread Return in the graveyard. By manipulating your library and graveyard, you can set up a combo with Thassa's Oracle or Nadu, Winged Wisdom to win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect your combo. The key is to efficiently set up your graveyard while keeping control of the game until you can assemble your winning combo.
